messages:
Lena: Big shoutout to everyone checking commute status this morning. I just got soaked on the 9th St overpass when a city truck splashed through a puddle. Who else is out there? :sweat_drops:
Omar: I was walking down from Soma. Splash zone confirmed. Bus 12 diverted because of a sinkhole (?) near 3rd and Townsend. Police tape, very dramatic. :police_car:
Tess: At Embarcadero, waterproof jacket = lifesaver. Also grabbed an extra pair of socks from my bag for a coworker. Casual office hero moment. :superhero:
Ben: Train into town was fine but shuttle to the office is on the slower side. ETA +12. If anyone needs a lift from Mission Bay I have space for two in my car.
Heather: Can we get the #random community to update a quick "commute status" ticker? Leave a one-line reply with your neighborhood + how you got in. I'll compile into a tiny map. :world_map:
WeatherBot: City Weather Alert: heavy showers 7:30-9:30AM; localized street flooding possible. Keep distance from runoff. https://weather.example/alert/9921
Lena: @Ben I might take the ride if you're not full. Also, to whoever left a towel in the kitchen 17:30 life-saver.
Omar: Quick PSA  don't put wet shoes on carpeted desks. Learned that today.
Tess: Micro poll: bring spare socks to breakroom? React :socks: if you'll donate, :point_up: if you need some.
Ben: :socks: leaving a pair at concierge labeled "for commutters" (typo intentional).
Heather: Adding a "commute ticker" doc in the #random pinned links. People, drop one-line updates there.
Lena: Also re: sinkhole  the city put up an official detour sign. If your route goes near 3rd/Townsend avoid it.
Omar: Mission Bay -> office: bike + dry layers worked best today. But helmet + puddle = new definition of shower.
Ben: Dropped two people off. Felt like UberPool but with extra towels.
Tess: Report from breakroom: warm tea and spare socks available. Whoever stocked that, we appreciate you. :heart:
Lena: Alright folks, commute log updated. If you didn't make it in, ping your manager and wave at Slack HQ's imaginary sun. Stay safe! :sun_behind_rain_cloud:
